name: P/E and PEG helper
summary: Price-to-earnings and optional PEG from a growth percent you supply.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. PE = price/EPS. PEG = PE/growthPct when growth is given. Does not scrape filings.
